title: Paul Muller confiscates and destroys Vallee's tracking tape

tellings.quote: His superior at the observatory, Paul Muller, got a hold of the data. The next morning, Muller, who behaved like a petty army officer, simply confiscated the tape and destroyed it.

plain: In the early 1960s, at a French observatory where the young Jacques Vallee, later a well-known UFO researcher, was working, his superior Paul Muller got hold of a tape of Vallee's tracking data. The next morning Muller confiscated the tape and destroyed it, behaving, as the story puts it, "like a petty army officer". Michels tells this himself in an episode with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, without naming a source, as an example of an early observatory record of something unexplained being thrown away.
